audit attribution [ADR-0013 control 10] is already provided by the kernel — a SHA-256-sealed append-only audit_log row per write and per refusal, naming the AUTHENTICATED userId, FND-02) + slice 6 the BARCODE-ASSIGNMENT leg of delivery (the command carries each barcode as {code,kind} — the symbology is a real authoring fact, never guessed;
